newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: National dips 2.17 pct on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: National dips 2.17 pct on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares of National Development Bank Ltd fell 2.17 percent or five rupees to 225 on profit-taking in early Monday trade, brokers said.
"There is some more profit to take at current levels for investors who got in at around 200 rupees," said a local broker.
The shares rose to a high of 275 rupees from 190 in the recent rally which ended on April 23.

Colombo's overall stock market has been supported by good growth expectations, easing interest rates and an agreement between the government and opposition to work together to end Sri Lanka's ethnic crisis.
